review_brief:
# Review return: two native parametric builds

## 34f8510e39d0

The existing base was already mature, so I preserved its generator and exact
canonical Racket program. I added `scope=all_green|largest_only`. The alternate
must segment the current input's solid green rectangles, rank their areas, and
outline only the unique largest rectangle. Matched inputs include an exact-shape
non-green distractor, so color and inferred object identity remain necessary.

Fresh evidence covers 62 target tests, 32 seeds, 320 episodes, 2,560 labeled
pairs, every 2–6 demo prefix, four queries, protected Racket authoring preflight,
a changing-output smallest-rectangle counterfactual, and first-turn projection
privacy. The 30×30 query is substantive rather than padded.

## d3ace3f5d190

The retained generator description and domain were wrong: the exact program
uses reflected nonzero precedence, not only below-diagonal copying, and the old
sampler never exposed conflicting transposed cells. Several declared controls
were inert and unknown controls were silently accepted. Version 2.0.0 corrects
the prose, rejects invalid controls, makes every retained control observable,
uses both diagonal sides, and includes conflicts that distinguish replacement
from copy-into-blanks. All five canonical labels replay unchanged.

I added `axis_rule=main|anchor_selected`. The alternate finds a unique color-8
corner anchor, derives main versus anti diagonal, and then mirrors through that
input-selected axis. The minimum two-demo prefix includes both axis decisions
and eliminates opposite-rule, always-anti, blank-only, and move-only rivals.
The bounded audit covers 320 episodes and 2,560 pairs; protected preflight
replays 40 Racket evaluations. The protected wrong-axis witness changes the
final output. Public export checks pass for 16 one-query views, 24 private-field
invariance mutations, and four positive controls.

## Status and limits

Both entries are reviewer-ready authoring returns. Neither is owner-accepted,
promoted into the production parametric API, or admitted to training. The owner
must review and integrate these exact sources, then rerun native qualification
and acceptance. Finite rivals and seed schedules do not prove universal lesson
uniqueness.
